messages:
Sam: hit a nasty onboarding hiccup. JS SDK + tsconfig + edge bundle -> consumers get TS errors only in edge builds. Node ESM is fine, but Vite/esbuild -> TS2345 and "Property \"foo\" does not exist on type \"unknown\"" when calling client.chat.create().

Jess: classic. can you paste tsconfig + package.json export shape?

Sam: minimal repro: package.json 'type': 'module', exports: { './sdk': { 'import': './dist/esm/index.js', 'default': './dist/cjs/index.js' } }, types -> dist/index.d.ts. tsconfig: module: 'esnext', target: 'ES2022', moduleResolution: 'bundler', esModuleInterop: true.

Owen: bundler MR can cause types to resolve to tslib/namespace shapes. try moduleResolution: 'nodenext' or add typesVersions to map ESM consumers to ./dist/esm/index.d.ts.

Sam: error is Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string' (2345) at client.chat.create(...). Overloads in index.d.ts are string | PromptObject, but after bundling it becomes unknown.

Liya: overload narrowing like that usually means import shape changed (default vs namespace). are you using import client from 'redwood-sdk' or import * as client?

Sam: default import. Everything compiles in plain node ESM. Fails only when Vite esbuild bundles the app for edge.

Jess: bundlers sometimes rewrite exports to CJS-like shape which breaks overload resolution. options: ship separate .d.ts per export shape; or tighten overloads using generics and type guards (yuck).

Owen: i can add an esm-flavored declaration file that uses 'export default' types matching package conditional exports. Then set typesVersions and update package.exports to point TypeScript consumers to the right d.ts.

Liya: i'll draft a small sample repo for edge runtimes (Vercel, Cloudflare) showing recommended tsconfig: moduleResolution: 'nodenext', esModuleInterop: true, allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true, typesVersions mapping to ./dist/esm, and note bundler quirks.

Sam: can we also document the tradeoffs for unknown->any? teams sometimes patch with 'skipLibCheck' or loosen strictness which masks real issues. we should avoid suggesting 'any'.

Jess: agree. add a "edge types troubleshooting" doc to DevEx samples. include quick fixes: change imports, typesVersions, amd shipping separate d.ts; sample tsconfig that works.

ci-bot: build #4221 failed: devex/samples/edge-sdk-onboard — tsc error 2345 (https://ci.example/4221)

Owen: opening PR to add esm .d.ts and sample. assigning to @Liya for docs and sample CI matrix.

Sam: i'll push the minimal repro into the sample repo in ~30m. thanks all :raised_hands:

Liya: created issue #1123 and tagged sdk team.

Jess: once PR lands run tests across node ESM, CJS, and edge builder matrix.

Sam: will include failing CI link in PR and a note about how to reproduce with vite+esbuild.
